definitions.explanation: Praying or wishing earnestly for something good to come about. Formal, and used above all for public, collective wishes such as peace, safety, or recovery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祈念|きねん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祈念|きねん}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I pray for everyone's good health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{式典|しきてん}→式典：09526_shikiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{祈念|きねん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At the ceremony, prayers were offered for the earliest possible recovery of the disaster-stricken area.

notes:
Do not confuse with its homophone ⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧ (commemoration), which is far more common. The two appear side by side in names such as ⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧{祈念|きねん}⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ (Peace Prayer Statue) versus ⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦{館|かん}→館：17308_kan⟧ (memorial hall).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祈念|きねん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pray for peace
- ご{多幸|たこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祈念|きねん}⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: I wish you every happiness (set closing phrase)
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧{祈念|きねん}: prayer for safety
- {祈念|きねん}⟦{式典|しきてん}→式典：09526_shikiten⟧: a memorial prayer ceremony

REGISTER:
Written and ceremonial. In speech, ordinary people say ⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧; {祈念|きねん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ belongs to speeches, formal letters, and ceremonies.
